basics.summary: I am studying for a B.A. in Computer Science in the Department of Information and Computer Sciences at the University of Hawaii. I expect to graduate in Spring, 2027.

highlights: Provided technical support to students, faculty, and staff via phone, email, and walk-in service.
Diagnosed and troubleshooted a wide range of hardware and software issues, including campus network connectivity, university email clients, and learning management system access
Collaborated with senior IT staff to escalate complex issues and contribute to team-wide problem-solving efforts.
